78189.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Trump crypto investors are $4.7B underwater, advocacy group says
78189.body:
Circle strikes Chelsea front-of-shirt sponsorship deal featuring USDC | Bitwise fund is first Solana ETF to hit $1 billion AUM | IREN's $25 billion-$30 billion AI buildout may have 'spooked' investors, Bernstein says | BitGo buys NYDIG's institutional trading business, expanding derivatives offering |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Jason Shubnell

Presented By:

( https://thezcashetf.com/?utm_campaign=website-traffic-zcsh-newsletters--2026-08-25&utm_medium=paid-other&utm_source=the-block&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Friday 🎉 *Bitcoin* slipped back below $78,000 after *Fed* Chair *Kevin Warsh* warned ( https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/speech/warsh20260828a.htm?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) at Jackson Hole that policymakers still have "work to do" if inflation fails to cool sufficiently.

In today's newsletter, *Public Citizen* says investors are at least $4.7 billion underwater on *Trump's* crypto projects, *Circle* strikes a sponsorship deal with Premier League club *Chelsea* , *Bitwise's BSOL* becomes the first $1 billion AUM *Solana* ETF, and more.

Meanwhile, *Upbit* parent *Dunamu* partners ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-28-dunamu-visa-partner-stablecoin-ai-ousd-412988?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) with *Visa* on a stablecoin and AI business.

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *the Bitcoin ETF inflow streak* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*👀 Investors at least $4.7 billion underwater across Trump crypto ventures, Public Citizen says*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-28-investors-at-least-4-7-billion-underwater-across-trump-crypto-ventures-public-citizen-says-413003?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Investors across five *Trump* -linked crypto projects are at least $4.7 billion underwater, largely reflecting unrealized losses, according to advocacy group *Public Citizen*.

* The largest amount relates to the *TRUMP* memecoin, with Public Citizen estimating about 1 million of roughly 1.6 million retail wallets down a combined $3.2 billion, though only about $400 million of that has been realized.
* The Official Trump token peaked at $73.43 in January 2025 before collapsing to around $2.73, with the earliest buyers capturing nearly 90% of retail gains, per the report.
* Public Citizen said Trump's own proceeds were almost all profit, since his tokens were allocated to his company rather than bought and his other income from the project came via licensing fees.
* *World Liberty Financial* accounts for another $1 billion-plus, per the report, including a $1.04 billion paper loss at *AI Financial Corp.* , whose shares have fallen 91% since it partnered wit
